title: The Frog Who Froze Solid 🐸🧊
yt_description:
Everyone laughed when Fen said his winter plan was to freeze solid… until spring. 🐸🧊
Wood frogs really do this: their heart stops, more than half the water in their body turns to ice, and their liver floods every cell with sugar that works like antifreeze. In spring they thaw and hop away. (Fen and Rocco are fictional; the science is real.)

Sources: US National Park Service (Gates of the Arctic, "Biological Miracle"); research by Ken & Janet Storey, Carleton University.

script: Winter is coming. And Fen the wood frog has a plan: freeze solid. Rocco the rabbit laughs. You'll be a frog popsicle! Frogs don't come back from ice! Fen just crawls under the leaves... and the snow covers him. Fen freezes. No heartbeat. No breathing. Even Rocco stops laughing. But Fen has a trick. Before the ice comes, his liver floods every cell with sugar. The sugar works like antifreeze. Ice forms around the cells, not inside them, so nothing breaks. Spring. The ice melts. Thump. Fen's heart beats again. Fen hops right past Rocco. See you next winter. Wood frogs really do this: more than half the water in their body turns to ice, and in spring they thaw back to life. And next winter? Fen will freeze again.
